Crypto RL Trading System - ByBit Perpetuals
description:
## Overview

Transform the existing Forex PPO trading system into a crypto perpetual futures trading system using ByBit exchange. The system will learn trading strategies based on the high win-rate SR Swing Strategy.

## Target Pairs
- SUI/USDT Perpetual
- SOL/USDT Perpetual  
- LINK/USDT Perpetual
- BNB/USDT Perpetual

## Success Criteria
- [ ] CCXT data pipeline fetches all 4 pairs from ByBit
- [ ] Dynamic fee fetching from exchange API
- [ ] Feature extractor implements SR Swing indicators
- [ ] PPO agent trains on crypto data without errors
- [ ] Backtest shows positive expectancy
- [ ] Paper trading validates real-time signals

## Background
Existing codebase trades EUR/USD with simple indicators. User wants to migrate to crypto perpetuals with sophisticated SR Swing Strategy (pivots, HMA, Kalman filters, MTF analysis).

## Scope
**In Scope:**
- CCXT integration for ByBit perpetuals
- Dynamic fee model via exchange API
- Strategy indicator migration (pivots, HMA, Kalman, etc.)
- Multi-timeframe feature engineering
- PPO training pipeline adaptation
- Backtesting and validation framework

**Out of Scope:**
- Live trading execution (paper trading only for now)
- Grid/martingale strategies
- Multi-account management
design:
## Architecture

### Data Layer (Phase 1)
- : CCXT integration for ByBit OHLCV + fee fetching
- : Centralized configuration
- : Parquet-based data storage

### Feature Layer (Phase 2)
- : Ported SR Swing indicators
- : State vector generation (37+ features)
- Multi-timeframe: LTF (5m/15m) + HTF (1h/4h)

### RL Layer (Phase 3)
- : Gymnasium environment for perpetuals
- : PPO training pipeline
- Dynamic fee model, 24/7 trading, percentage-based SL/TP

### Validation Layer (Phase 5)
- Walk-forward validation
- Cross-pair robustness testing
- Monte Carlo analysis

- velocity_score, atr_expansion
- mfi_value

### Filter Flags (6)
- rsi_oversold, rsi_overbought
- macd_bullish, macd_bearish
- bb_position, mtf_aligned

### Position State (3)

- unrealized_pnl_pct
- time_in_position

-  → np.ndarray

title: Create trading_env_crypto.py - RL environment for crypto
description:
Custom Gymnasium environment for crypto perpetual trading.

## Action Space - 6 discrete actions
0: HOLD - No action
1: LONG - Open long position
2: SHORT - Open short position
3: CLOSE - Close existing position
4: LONG_TIGHT - Long with tight SL/TP
5: SHORT_TIGHT - Short with tight SL/TP

## Key Differences from Forex
- Fee Model: Dynamic taker fee instead of fixed spread
- Trading Hours: 24/7 continuous instead of 5-day
- SL/TP: Percentage-based instead of pips
- Leverage: 1x-10x support

## Position Management
- SL: 2-5 percent depending on volatility
- TP: 2:1 or 3:1 risk:reward ratio
- Optional trailing SL
- Optional time exit (max bars in trade)

## Reward Function
reward = reward_pnl + reward_risk - penalty_fees - penalty_inactivity
design:
## Implementation

Extend existing trading_env.py, override:
- _get_observation - Use feature_extractor
- _calculate_reward - Dynamic fees, percent returns
- reset - Handle 24/7 data continuity
close_reason: Created trading_env.py: Gymnasium-compatible crypto trading env with 6 actions, dynamic fees, percentage SL/TP, reward shaping. Passes gymnasium check_env.

title: Create train_crypto.py - PPO training pipeline
description:
PPO training pipeline adapted for crypto perpetuals.

## Training Configuration

### Hyperparameters (Crypto-Optimized)
- total_steps: 1000000-2000000 (higher than forex)
- learning_rate: 1e-4 to 3e-4
- batch_size: 64-128
- n_steps: 2048-4096
- entropy_coef: 0.005-0.02
- clip_range: 0.1-0.2

### Curriculum Learning
Phase 1: SOL/USDT (highest liquidity)
Phase 2: Add SUI/USDT (different volatility)
Phase 3: Add LINK/USDT (mean-reverting)
Phase 4: Add BNB/USDT (lower volatility)

### Checkpointing
- Every 50K steps
- Best model selection based on Sharpe ratio
- TensorBoard logging
design:
## Metrics to Track
- Episode reward, length
- Policy/value loss
- Sharpe ratio (validation set)
- Win rate, profit factor
